features.name: counter_content_word_ttr
features.definition: What is the type-token ratio of content words (nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs) pooled across all counter-argument comments?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list of strings; malformed/missing -> null; empty list -> null (no tokens). Concatenate all comments, tokenize into lowercase alphabetic words, POS-tag (e.g. spaCy or NLTK), keep tokens tagged NOUN, VERB, ADJ, ADV (exclude auxiliaries, stopwords/function words, numbers, URLs). Lemmatize to lowercase lemmas. Value = number of distinct content lemmas / total content tokens; null if zero content tokens.

h0: counter_content_word_ttr has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view (delta).
h1: Higher counter_content_word_ttr is associated with a higher probability that the OP changed their view.
note: Persuasiveness is operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP view change); association only. Comments are pooled per row, so TTR is a row-level pooled measure and is strongly length-dependent (longer text lowers TTR); no length control is imposed beyond what rhs states. POS tagger and lemmatization are assumptions. Raw text may contain view-change or delta announcements; not filtered. Comment list may be incomplete and unordered.
